$comment: Hermetic tests by default (card xcu4cqf). Read by we:scripts/lib/hermetic-tests.mjs (the guard), we:scripts/lib/hermetic-test-scan.mjs (the ratchet), every vitest config (blocking configs exclude liveSuite.tests; vitest.live.config.ts runs only them) and pinned against we:.github/workflows/live-tests.yml (the cron must equal liveSuite.schedule.cron).

liveSuite.$comment: The ONLY tests allowed to reach live GitHub / remote refs / host state. They never run in a blocking suite (unit, integration, soak). They run on a schedule and a failure is reported as a health-smell issue, never as a PR or main gate. Each entry needs a reason; moving a test here is the opt-out marker.

tests.reason: the #2949 fidelity qualifier against the REAL gh binary: its whole claim is how a real, unauthenticated gh subprocess fails, which no fake can observe (moved out of the blocking integration tier)

guardedRoots.why: the machine-wide automation state home: the build queue, run scorecards, daemon last-good
real GitHub credentials and the gh shim
other lanes and the pool's lease/cache files (the checkout under test and its sibling repos are exempt)
the primary checkout's live backlog (exempt when the primary IS the checkout under test)

fakeHome.$comment: Hermetic runs give every test file a private, empty HOME (env HOME + os.homedir()), so a default path built from the home (~/.claude/*, ~/workspace/.lanes, ~/workspace/.operations) resolves into a throwaway fixture instead of the operator's live state. Tool caches below stay pointed at the REAL home (only when unset and present) so npx/playwright/cargo do not re-download.

fixtureRootEnv.$comment: Roots NOT derived from the home (the lane pool and telemetry dir are found from the checkout's own location, so a test run inside a lane would otherwise read its sibling lanes). Hermetic runs point each at a private, empty per-file dir unless the launcher already set it.

liveReaders.why: its defaults read gh + origin/main backlog (readDelivery), the jobs registry, the real backoff store and lane pool — the 2026-10-08 main-red incident
defaults to gh pr list + git show origin/main:backlog
